sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the skin and the digestive system. It is useful in cases of skin diseases and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands.
sections.Skin: Eruptions, with much itching and burning. Erysipelas. Impetigo.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Abdomen: Distended and tender. Flatulence. Chronic diarrhoea.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Anacardium orientale; Rhus toxicodendron; Cantharis.
